seoTitle: Change Your Hostinger Domain Name for Free
metaDescription: Update the domain name attached to your Hostinger website through hPanel, with a warning about email data before you start.
intro: If you're rebranding or want a fresh start with a new domain, Hostinger lets you change the domain attached to your website directly from hPanel. This guide covers finding the option and what to check before proceeding, since existing email data will be affected.

steps.heading: Log in to Hostinger
steps.body: Go to Hostinger's homepage, click the login option at the top right, and enter your credentials.

steps.heading: Open the Website section in hPanel
steps.body: From your dashboard, go to the homepage and find the Website section listing your hosted domains.

steps.heading: Select Change Domain
steps.body: Find your website, click the three-dot icon next to it, and choose Change Domain from the menu.

steps.heading: Back up your email data first
steps.body: You'll see a notice that all email data tied to the domain will be deleted — back up anything important before checking the acknowledgment box.

steps.heading: Enter and confirm your new domain
steps.body: Click Change, carefully type in the new domain name, double-check for typos, then click Next to complete the update.

faq.question: Will changing my domain delete my email data?
faq.answer: Yes, Hostinger warns that all email data associated with the domain will be deleted, so back up anything important first.

faq.question: How long does it take for the new domain to work everywhere?
faq.answer: Propagation can take some time, so your new domain may not be immediately accessible from all parts of the world.

faq.question: Where do I find the Change Domain option?
faq.answer: Click the three-dot icon next to your website in the Website section of hPanel, then select Change Domain.

faq.question: What if I run into issues after changing my domain?
faq.answer: Reach out to Hostinger's support team for assistance if the new domain doesn't behave as expected.
